# Hyphenated query terms are quoted per token, so `akb search 'event-driven'`
# matches pages whose content contains `event-driven`.

exec akb init rebuild-search-hyphen-kb
cd rebuild-search-hyphen-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write second-rebuild-note.md

exec akb index rebuild

exec akb search 'event-driven'
stdout 'notes/second-rebuild-note.md'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Second Rebuild Note
summary: Another note for rebuild-search
tags: rebuildsearch
---
Content about event-driven architecture and messaging.
